_comment: Sample run config for gen-prompts.py --group auth (DM-Y, review fix F-05, 2026-10-27). Run sample01, env e2e-y-sample01, logins dmseed-<role> and ids are fakes: fill employees from the R1 claims / auth-allocation.md (seed A1; every role of rules.json, optional IMPBLK / DISU = claimed spares; NOEMP stays {login none, id 0} when seed A8 is skipped; TA = the steward's kit actor from kits/<env>). No days: auth has no day rules. User-supplied, fake here: AUTH_MAILBOX (the team-owned mailbox confirmed in AUT-G3; never a seeded or personal address), PIDOPS_PROFILE and PORTAL_PROFILE (headed ops sign-ins, outside results/), PROVIDER_ID (gate AUT-G1 provider-read). Test: gen-prompts.py <this file> --group auth --dry-run (exit 0, no NEEDS CONFIG line); a real run adds --claims.
